scope: Admin catalog: bulk CSV import of product models + indicative quote ranges

businessFlow.subject: Import a CSV of product models with indicative quote ranges; missing categories/brands are created and re-running is idempotent by slug
steps: sign in as demo admin (email + password + development MFA code 123456)
paste a CSV with header category,brand,name,model_code,low_value,high_value and one data row
submit and verify the banner reads Imported 1 model, skipped 0
re-submit the same CSV and verify the banner reads Imported 0 models, skipped 1 (idempotent)
verify no console errors during the flow

notes: Server derives slugs, creates missing categories/brands, and records an indicative price targeting exactly the product model. No console errors observed.
